summary: US and Saudi Arabia jointly struck pro-Iranian militia positions across seven Iraqi provinces, killing at least 20 and wounding 32, following IRGC missile fire at a US base in Jordan. IDF destroyed a Hezbollah underground command tunnel in southern Lebanon and is deliberating a response to a recent Hezbollah drone violation of the ceasefire. Iran is reportedly receiving Chinese short-range air defense systems and has placed extraordinary demands on Hormuz Strait transit.
key_points: US and Saudi Arabia struck pro-Iranian militia bases in Baghdad, Wasit, Nineveh, Basra, Kirkuk, Karbala, and Diyala, killing at least 20 and wounding 32. (Source: VahidOnline/77608)

IDF destroyed a Hezbollah underground command tunnel approximately 55 meters long with three rooms and dozens of weapons under a construction factory in southern Lebanon, ~300 meters from a UNIFIL building. (Source: inon_yttach/9720)

Hezbollah fired an explosive drone at an IDF engineering vehicle on Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon's buffer zone, the first ceasefire violation since the late June framework; no injuries reported. (Source: idf_telegram/24759)
Iran is reportedly set to receive 300 to 400 Chinese QW-12 and FN-16 MANPADS within weeks, valued at $60 to $70 million, delivered via air from Urumqi through Pakistan. (Source: VahidOnline/77606)

Iran placed extraordinary demands on Hormuz Strait passage, rejected by the US, Saudi Arabia, and the international community, with significant gaps remaining between the parties. (Source: pkpoi/143469)
IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir said the military is prepared for war to continue on any front and will push deeper into Lebanon if required. (Source: manniefabian/58892)
Israel ruled out any additional withdrawals from Lebanon in upcoming negotiations, insisting on retaining freedom of action in areas transferred to the Lebanese Armed Forces. (Source: presstv/200797)

iran: Iran placed extraordinary demands regarding passage through the Hormuz Strait, which were rejected by the United States, Saudi Arabia, and the international community, leaving significant gaps between the parties. (Source: pkpoi/143469)

Iran is reportedly set to receive 300 to 400 Chinese-manufactured QW-12 and FN-16 short-range air defense MANPADS within weeks, valued at $60 to $70 million, with delivery routed via air from Urumqi through Pakistan. (Source: VahidOnline/77606)

The contract for the MANPADS was reportedly signed with Zhongqing Baoshang International Investment, a Hong Kong-based intermediary, with the Chinese Foreign Ministry calling the reports completely baseless. (Source: VahidOnline/77606)
Iran is reportedly close to a separate agreement with China to purchase anti-ship cruise missiles, though the deal's finalization status is unclear. (Source: VahidOnline/77606)

Iranian security officials reportedly believe the QW-12 system, while less advanced than newer QW-18 and QW-19 models, can still provide an effective short-range defense layer against low-altitude drones and helicopters. (Source: VahidOnline/77606)
The IRGC commander is reportedly the decision-maker for Iran's military operations, according to a senior intermediary state official. (Source: N12chat/219839)
Iran's Foundation for the Documentation of Executions reported at least 886 executions in Iran from the start of 2026 through the present, with 56 in July alone. (Source: VahidOnline/77607)
israel: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir visited southern Lebanon and stated the military is prepared for war to continue on any front, including pushing deeper into Lebanese territory if required. (Source: manniefabian/58892)

Israel declared it will not agree to any additional withdrawals from Lebanon in the next round of negotiations with the Beirut government, while insisting on retaining freedom of action in transferred areas. (Source: presstv/200797)

IDF destroyed a Hezbollah underground command headquarters under a construction materials factory in the southern Lebanon security zone, with a tunnel approximately 55 meters long containing three rooms and dozens of weapons. (Source: inon_yttach/9720)

Hezbollah fired an explosive drone at an IDF engineering vehicle on Ali Taher Ridge in the southern Lebanon buffer zone, which the IDF called a blatant violation of the ceasefire agreement. (Source: idf_telegram/24759)

Four people were injured near Qadita in northern Israel when a land vehicle incident occurred; a 23-year-old woman suffered moderate leg injuries and three others sustained light injuries. (Source: N12chat/219841)
Israel is currently deliberating a response to the Hezbollah drone attack on Ali Taher Ridge, the first such violation since the late June framework agreement. (Source: manniefabian/58887)

sections.threat_assessment: The US-Saudi joint strikes on pro-Iranian militias across Iraq represent a significant escalation in the regional conflict, directly targeting IRGC-directed forces that have conducted over 24 drone attacks against US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure. Iran's reported acquisition of 300 to 400 Chinese MANPADS within weeks will materially enhance its short-range air defense capability and could complicate coalition air operations. Hezbollah's drone attack on Ali Taher Ridge, the first violation of the late June ceasefire framework, signals continued hostilities in Lebanon despite the agreement. Iran's extraordinary demands on Hormuz Strait transit, rejected by the US and Saudi Arabia, indicate unresolved tensions that could further disrupt global energy markets already reflected in the 7% Brent crude price surge past $90 per barrel.
sections.regional_response: The United States and Saudi Arabia conducted coordinated airstrikes across seven Iraqi provinces targeting IRGC-aligned militias, with US CENTCOM framing the operation as counterterrorism against Iran-directed groups. Israel has declared it will not withdraw further from Lebanon and insists on freedom of action in transferred areas, while IDF Chief of Staff Zamir signaled readiness to expand operations deeper into Lebanese territory. Pakistan's ISPR has denied any involvement in facilitating arms transfers from China to Iran, and China's Foreign Ministry dismissed reports of the MANPADS deal as baseless. Ansar Allah in Yemen is reportedly considering transit fees for commercial vessels through the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, adding pressure to Red Sea shipping security.
sections.intelligence_notes: The reported killing of four named IRGC members in Karbala during the US-Saudi strikes suggests precision targeting of IRGC personnel embedded with militia forces, potentially degrading command and control capabilities. The delivery route for Chinese MANPADS via air from Urumqi through Pakistan indicates Iran is seeking covert supply chains to circumvent scrutiny, though Pakistan has publicly denied involvement. The IDF's discovery of a 55-meter underground tunnel with three rooms and dozens of weapons near a UNIFIL building in southern Lebanon raises concerns about Hezbollah's ability to conceal operational infrastructure in proximity to international forces. The IRGC's reported role as the ultimate decision-maker for Iranian military operations, as stated by a senior intermediary, underscores the centralized command structure that complicates de-escalation efforts.
